description: This file contains implementation of various audio command classes for the Android Open Source Project, including commands for retrieving jack info, channel map info, PCM stream info, and controlling streams, with methods for replying and handling audio command data.

classes.name: AudioCommand
classes.description: Base class for audio commands, managing command lifecycle and status checks.

classes.name: JackInfoCommand
classes.description: Handles the retrieval and reply of jack information in the audio system.

classes.name: ChmapInfoCommand
classes.description: Handles the retrieval and reply of channel map information.

classes.name: StreamInfoCommand
classes.description: Manages PCM stream information retrieval and reply.

classes.name: StreamControlCommand
classes.description: Base class for stream control commands, such as start, stop, or set parameters.

classes.name: StreamSetParamsCommand
classes.description: Sets parameters for an audio stream, such as buffer size, format, and rate.

methods.name: Reply
methods.description: Handles the reply for the specific command, updating internal state based on the response.

methods.name: MarkReplied
methods.description: Marks the command as having received a reply.
